commands.summary: Run the caller ids ETL stream
examples: pm callrail caller ids list --json
pm callrail calls list --json
pm callrail companies list --json

commands.summary: Plan and execute the create caller id reverse-ETL action
examples: pm callrail create caller id apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: registers an outbound caller-id number and immediately triggers a real verification phone call to it; a real-world side effect, approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the create company reverse-ETL action
examples: pm callrail create company apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: creates a new company (a billable tracking entity) within the account; approval recommended
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the create integration reverse-ETL action
examples: pm callrail create integration apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: creates and activates a Webhooks or Custom-cookie-capture integration for a company (the only 2 integration types the API can create); approval recommended since Webhooks integrations push call data to an external URL
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the create integration filter reverse-ETL action
examples: pm callrail create integration filter apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: adds a filter narrowing which calls trigger an existing integration; low-risk external mutation, no approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the create message flow reverse-ETL action
examples: pm callrail create message flow apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: creates a new automated SMS message flow (a step-graph of tag/response actions) for a company; low-risk external mutation, no approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute
commands.notes: named_dependency=engine.reverse_etl_scalar_flag_contract: the reverse-ETL command surface cannot faithfully expose this action's required object or array record fields as scalar flags

commands.summary: Plan and execute the create notification reverse-ETL action
examples: pm callrail create notification apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: creates a call/text alert subscription for a user; low-risk external mutation, no approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the create outbound call reverse-ETL action

flags.name: business_phone_number
flags.summary: Required business phone number record field.

flags.name: customer_phone_number
flags.summary: Required customer phone number record field.

examples: pm callrail create outbound call apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: places a real outbound phone call connecting a business and a customer number (US/Canada only); a real-world side effect outside the CallRail account itself, approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the create tag reverse-ETL action
examples: pm callrail create tag apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: creates a new call/text tag definition visible account- or company-wide; low-risk external mutation, no approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the create user reverse-ETL action
examples: pm callrail create user apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: creates a new CallRail user and emails them a password-setup prompt; requires an administrator-scoped API key; approval recommended
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the delete caller id reverse-ETL action
examples: pm callrail delete caller id apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: removes an outbound caller id from the company; irreversible, low-risk, no approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the delete integration filter reverse-ETL action
examples: pm callrail delete integration filter apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: removes a filter; the parent integration keeps firing for every call, unfiltered, once this is removed; low-risk, no approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the delete message flow reverse-ETL action
examples: pm callrail delete message flow apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: permanently removes a message flow; any tracker still referencing it stops running the automated SMS steps; irreversible, approval recommended
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the delete notification reverse-ETL action
examples: pm callrail delete notification apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: permanently removes a notification subscription (restricted to notifications managed by the current user); irreversible, low-risk, no approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the delete tag reverse-ETL action
examples: pm callrail delete tag apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: permanently removes a tag, including from every call/text interaction it has been applied to; irreversible, approval recommended
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute
commands.notes: named_dependency=engine.reverse_etl_scalar_flag_contract: the reverse-ETL command surface cannot faithfully expose this action's required object or array record fields as scalar flags

commands.summary: Plan and execute the delete user reverse-ETL action
examples: pm callrail delete user apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: permanently removes a user's access to the account; requires an administrator-scoped API key; irreversible, approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the disable integration reverse-ETL action
examples: pm callrail disable integration apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: disables (the docs' own term; not a hard delete) an integration; stops any external data flow it previously drove; approval recommended
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the send text message reverse-ETL action

flags.name: customer_phone_number
flags.summary: Required customer phone number record field.

examples: pm callrail send text message apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: sends a real SMS/MMS text message to a customer's phone (subject to 10DLC business-registration compliance rules); a real-world side effect outside the CallRail account itself, approval required. Direct file-upload MMS (multipart media_file) is out of scope — see api_surface.json/docs.md; the media_url variant covers publicly-hosted-image MMS instead.
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Run the sms threads ETL stream
examples: pm callrail sms threads list --json
pm callrail tags list --json

commands.summary: Run the text messages ETL stream
examples: pm callrail text messages list --json
pm callrail trackers list --json

commands.summary: Plan and execute the update call reverse-ETL action
examples: pm callrail update call apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: applies tags/notes/lead-status/value/customer-name metadata to an existing call record; low-risk external mutation, no approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the update company reverse-ETL action
examples: pm callrail update company apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: updates company configuration; setting status to disabled deactivates all of the company's tracking numbers and its dynamic-number-insertion script — approval recommended for status changes
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the update integration reverse-ETL action
examples: pm callrail update integration apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: updates an integration's active/disabled state or its webhook/cookie-capture configuration; approval recommended
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the update integration filter reverse-ETL action
examples: pm callrail update integration filter apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: updates an integration filter's trigger criteria; low-risk external mutation, no approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the update message flow reverse-ETL action
examples: pm callrail update message flow apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: replaces an existing message flow's step graph; the docs' own endpoint takes no {message_flow_id} path segment, identifying the flow purely via the body's id field; low-risk external mutation, no approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute
commands.notes: named_dependency=engine.reverse_etl_scalar_flag_contract: the reverse-ETL command surface cannot faithfully expose this action's required object or array record fields as scalar flags

commands.summary: Plan and execute the update notification reverse-ETL action
examples: pm callrail update notification apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: updates an existing notification's scope/channel settings; low-risk external mutation, no approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the update sms thread reverse-ETL action
examples: pm callrail update sms thread apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: applies notes/value/tags/lead-qualification metadata to an existing SMS thread; low-risk external mutation, no approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the update tag reverse-ETL action
examples: pm callrail update tag apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: renames/recolors/disables a tag; renaming changes the tag everywhere it is currently assigned; low-risk external mutation, no approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute
commands.notes: named_dependency=engine.reverse_etl_scalar_flag_contract: the reverse-ETL command surface cannot faithfully expose this action's required object or array record fields as scalar flags

commands.summary: Plan and execute the update tracker reverse-ETL action
examples: pm callrail update tracker apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: reconfigures an existing (already-provisioned) session or source tracker's call flow, whisper message, SMS setting, or source rules; does not provision/deprovision a phone number itself, unlike create/disable; low-risk external mutation, no approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the update user reverse-ETL action
examples: pm callrail update user apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: updates a user's profile/role/company access; name/email changes are restricted to the API key's own owning user by CallRail; approval recommended for role/company changes
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

examples: pm callrail users list --json
